title: Coefficient-independent exchange pasting over a projective-line isomorphism
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X -> S proper and i:X ≅ P=ProjectiveLine(S) over S, with q:P -> S. Put V=X times_S X, W=P times_S P and w=i times_S i, using the maps of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. For every M in D(P_et,A), the following two maps from R(p1_X)! L(p2_X)^* Li^* M to Li^* Lq^* Rq_* M agree. The first is R(p1_X)! of the pullback-square comparison for p2, then projectionComparison for p1, then Li^* of inverse ordinary exchange on W [lem-sf-p1-chart-exchange]. The second is inverse compact-support exchange on V, then Lf^* of proper forget-supports, inverse direct-image composition for i;q=f, and Rq_* of pushPull(i), then the pullback compositor Lf^* -> Li^* Lq^*. There are no Tate twists, normalized line maps, trace arrows or constant-object unit comparisons in this statement.

source.place: The first-coordinate calculation: the composition isomorphism for derived direct images and the same canonical pullback counits.

proof.text: Expand projectionComparison into proper forget-supports and inverse ordinary exchange. Naturality moves the first-projection forget-supports hom past the pullback-square hom. The inverse equation of proper_self_exchange_forget_supports identifies inverse supported self-exchange followed by pullback of proper forget-supports with the first-projection proper comparison followed by inverse ordinary self-exchange.

Prove the source-change exchange equation by transposing under the first-projection derived adjunction. The defining mate-counit equation, the conjugate-compositor counit formula, naturality, and the presentation adjunction triangle reduce it to pullback-compositor associativity. Independently apply the proved source-library derivedBaseChangeMap_paste to the projective self-product square and the first-projection presentation square. Both calculations give the exchange of the same outer rectangle. Cancel the common final pullback compositor; the remaining pair of compositors is exactly the second-projection derivedSquareUpperStarIso.

The normalization unit_comp_pushPull identifies the actual presentation adjunction unit with pushPull.inv. Hence the coefficient comparison in the preceding source-change calculation is the isomorphism Rq_*(pushPull.inv) followed by rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq.hom; its inverse is exactly the direct-image-composition inverse followed by Rq_*(pushPull.hom) appearing in the statement. Isomorphism cancellation turns the forward pasting equation into the desired inverse ordinary-exchange equation. Combine with step 1 to recover the supported equation, without changing coefficients or adding hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: T2: explicit derived mate transposition, source-change and stacked-square pasting, and cancellation by the proved unit_comp_pushPull; first-coordinate calculation with the specified canonical maps.

theorem exchangeIsoTransport
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (projection f false)).map
        ((derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (projectionSquare f i hi true).toCommSq).hom.app M) ≫
      (projectionComparison A f i hi false).hom.app
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A
          (projectiveLineDiagonalProjection S true)).obj M) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
        ((properExchange A (projectiveProjectionSquare S false)).inv.app M) =
    (SfDiagonalKernel.exchangeFirst A f).inv.app
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj M) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj M) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i.hom
            (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) f hi).inv.app
              ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj M) ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map
            ((pushPull A i).hom.app M)) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i.hom
        (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) f hi.symm).hom.app
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj M)
